categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Adds a new fuzzing harness target (p2p_transport_v2_receive) and has the Fuzzing label.
categories.rationale: Adds fuzz coverage for exposed network handling that existing harnesses miss. The description notes that 'no fuzz target feeds V2Transport bytes that an honest peer would not send past the v2 key exchange', filling a critical fuzzing gap in network-facing BIP324 post-handshake deserialization.
